title: Supreme Commander
notes: Supreme Commander has online play, so Vault never reads its memory. It reads the campaign record the game keeps in its settings file (Game.prefs) when you win an operation.
Operations you already won count too. Difficulty achievements use the hardest difficulty you won each operation on.
This is the original Supreme Commander campaign, not Forged Alliance.

testGuide.title: Win an operation
testGuide.detail: Win any campaign operation and go back to the menu. "Commander on Deck" and that operation should pop.
